generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent four-component 2D puppet atlas for an original browser cat musician. Create ONE square RGBA transparent image arranged as a strict invisible 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal-sized tiles. Exactly ONE detached component per tile, generous 12% transparent safe margin inside each quadrant, absolutely nothing crossing middle boundaries. No labels, no background, no cast shadows, no props, no instrument, no whole character. Character direction: a very appealing cute AND cool little indie cat musician, compact and softly sculpted like a beautifully designed matte clay animation character, confident and curious, original character. Midnight ink-blue fur without detailed hair, warm cream muzzle and natural cream toe tips, subtle lavender inside ears, amber-gold irises. Wide softly squared round kitten cheeks, short small muzzle, tiny dark triangular nose. Large almond-rounded eyes with large colored irises, few eye whites, bright attentive gaze directed gently down towards an instrument; NOT sleepy, smug, angry, sneering or judgmental. Asymmetry: one ear tip subtly bent, same side consistently. Tiny asymmetric friendly half-smile. Sculptural, tasteful, quiet, not generic baby merchandise, not long human legs, not white cartoon gloves, not giant hands. TOP LEFT: isolated complete front-facing HEAD including both ears and whiskers, no neck or torso or headphones. The head is broad, cheeks soft, eyes clearly open, complete ear silhouettes, same soft diffuse lighting. TOP RIGHT: isolated compact sitting pear-shaped TORSO with a small hooked cat tail curling at its side within the tile, a small warm cream chest patch; no head, ears, arms, front paws, feet or headphones. Rounded shoulders have enough solid body overlap to attach separate forearms, no ear-like points. BOTTOM LEFT: ONE complete viewer-left short rounded FOREARM AND CAT PAW, diagonal from upper left shoulder root to lower right paw tip. The paw is a natural rounded closed feline mitten with two tiny toe separations and cream toe tips, no opposable thumb, no fingers, no glove cuff; forearm long enough to pivot from shoulder while the round paw stays clear. BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE complete viewer-right FOREARM AND PAW, matching identity and scale, diagonal upper right root to lower left tip. All FOUR detached components share front camera, ink-blue matte clay material, subtle volume, same soft frontal lighting, clear clean silhouette. Produce attractive high-end character design with charm and presence, restrained detail, no toy glossy plastic, no fur strands. It must be possible to assemble head over torso with independently rotating paws. Real transparent alpha everywhere outside objects, including between all four components; no fake checkerboard, no opaque cream board. No text, no watermark, no frame.
generation.inspection: Head, torso with feet/tail, two natural paw/forearm components. Fur is more detailed than requested matte clay; do not claim exact prompt compliance. Components use the same quadrant layout; torso feet remain behind instrument.

runtime.method: SVG clipping, separate source-shoulder/toe transforms and immediately contacted surfaces. WAAPI 150ms rebound; same-side retrigger cancels only that side. Drumstick and paw rebound together.
runtime.contactRules: Piano by actual key; guitar soundhole plus fret grip; 7 physical kit surfaces including shared open/closed hi-hat and a foot pedal; mixed-mode percussion on visible electronic pads.
